@@ R01 returns table col named fe, use_variable, guard reads variable
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f(v text) RETURNS TABLE(fe text) LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ #variable_conflict use_variable
BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NULL; END $$
@@ R02 OUT param named fe, use_variable
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f(v text, OUT fe text) LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ #variable_conflict use_variable
BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NULL; END $$
@@ R03 IN param named fe use_variable (control)
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f(fe text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ #variable_conflict use_variable
BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NULL; END $$
@@ R04 DO use_variable + EXECUTE const: ar reads stored
DO $$ #variable_conflict use_variable
DECLARE ar text; BEGIN EXECUTE 'UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = ar || ''x'''; END $$
@@ R05 DO use_variable; nested CREATE FUNCTION sql inside EXECUTE
DO $$ #variable_conflict use_variable
DECLARE ar text; BEGIN EXECUTE 'CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.g() RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql AS ''UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = ar || 1'''; END $$
@@ R06 plpgsql use_variable; fill with stored shadowed by var: COALESCE(fe,$1)
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f(v text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ #variable_conflict use_variable
DECLARE fe text; BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(fe, $1); END $$
@@ R07 variable_conflict in a comment, real default error
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f(fe text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
/* #variable_conflict use_column */
BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NULL; END $$
@@ R08 variable_conflict use_column in string literal later in the body
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f(fe text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN PERFORM '#variable_conflict use_column'; UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NULL; END $$
@@ R09 hash-operator lookalike: x # variable_conflict use_column as expression
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f(fe text, variable_conflict int, use_column int) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN PERFORM 1 # variable_conflict use_column; UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NULL; END $$
@@ R10 two directives: use_column then use_variable (last wins in PG?)
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f(fe text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ #variable_conflict use_column
#variable_conflict use_variable
BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NULL; END $$
@@ R11 label-qualified
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f() RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
<<blk>> DECLARE ar text; BEGIN UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = blk.ar; END $$
@@ R12 loop record
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f() RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
DECLARE r record; BEGIN FOR r IN SELECT * FROM aveloxis_data.src LOOP UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = r.ar; END LOOP; END $$
@@ R13 loop record over target (stored through a record)
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f() RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
DECLARE r record; BEGIN FOR r IN SELECT * FROM aveloxis_data.repos LOOP UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = r.ar WHERE repo_id = r.repo_id; END LOOP; END $$
@@ R14 sql fn param named fe: guard is column (ok accept)
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.f(fe text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql AS $$ UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NULL $$
@@ R15 sql fn named like table, qualified param
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.repos(ar text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql AS $$ UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = repos.ar || 'x' $$
@@ R16 insert as excluded
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos AS excluded (repo_id, pnn) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET pnn = COALESCE(excluded.pnn, excluded.pnn)
@@ R17 conflict update pnn stored qualified by schema.table
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, pnn) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET pnn = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.pnn, aveloxis_data.repos.pnn)
@@ R18 update from with other schema's repos (same bare name)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(repos.fe, $1) FROM public.repos WHERE true
@@ R19 update: FROM function named like target
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(repos.fe, $1) FROM repos() WHERE true
@@ R20 lateral
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = l.v FROM LATERAL (SELECT r.ar AS v) l
@@ R21 set op subselect
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = (SELECT x FROM (SELECT $1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT o.ar FROM aveloxis_data.repos o) u LIMIT 1)
@@ R22 whole row field
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = (r.*)::text
@@ R23 whole-row via from alias of self
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = to_jsonb(r2)->>'ar' FROM aveloxis_data.repos r2 WHERE r2.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ R24 returning (no effect)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = $1 RETURNING ar
@@ R25 merge when not matched by source update
MERGE INTO aveloxis_data.repos t USING aveloxis_data.src s ON t.repo_id = s.repo_id WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE THEN UPDATE SET ar = t.ar
@@ R26 merge: source alias same as column; fe fill reading source
MERGE INTO aveloxis_data.repos t USING (SELECT repo_id, fe FROM aveloxis_data.repos) s ON t.repo_id = s.repo_id + 1 WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ar = s.fe
@@ R27 trigger NEW.ar := OLD.ar
CREATE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.tf() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.ar := OLD.ar; RETURN NEW; END $$
@@ R28 rule on other with OLD
CREATE RULE r AS ON UPDATE TO aveloxis_data.other DO ALSO UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = OLD.ar
@@ R29 quoted mixed case alias
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos "R" SET fe = COALESCE(r.fe, $1)
@@ R30 keepcarry with stored cast / other col
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET k = CASE WHEN $1 THEN k ELSE $2::timestamptz END
@@ R31 keepcarry with result NOW() AT TIME ZONE
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET k = CASE WHEN $1 THEN pg_catalog.now() ELSE k END
@@ R32 keepcarry result user schema now()
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET k = CASE WHEN $1 THEN evil.now() ELSE k END
@@ R33 earliest LEAST($1, e, extra)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET e = LEAST(e, $1::date)
@@ R34 greatest missing fallback same order
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET g = GREATEST(COALESCE($1, g), COALESCE($1, g))
@@ R35 greatest with two different params
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET g = GREATEST(COALESCE($1, g), COALESCE(g, $2))
@@ R36 pnn with different param cast truncation
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET pnn = COALESCE($1::varchar(1), pnn)
@@ R37 pn nullif incoming cast then stored
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET pn = COALESCE(NULLIF($1::text, ''), pn)
@@ R38 fe second arg subselect of other table
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(fe, (SELECT o.x FROM aveloxis_data.other o LIMIT 1))
@@ R39 fe coalesce stored with collate
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(fe COLLATE "C", $1)
@@ R40 fe guard collate
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE COALESCE(fe, '') = '' COLLATE "C"
@@ R41 fe guard with char padding semantic: fe = '' OR fe IS NULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE (fe = '' OR fe IS NULL) AND repo_id = $2
@@ R42 guard on other row via FROM alias
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 FROM aveloxis_data.repos r2 WHERE r2.fe IS NULL
@@ R43 guard with target unaliased but qualified by name while FROM has alias "repos"
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 FROM aveloxis_data.other repos WHERE repos.fe IS NULL
@@ R44 guard: 3-part
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE aveloxis_data.repos.fe IS NULL
@@ R45 guard NULLIF IS NULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE NULLIF(fe, '') IS NULL AND TRUE
@@ R46 guard bare fe with FROM (ambiguous if other has fe; else target)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 FROM aveloxis_data.other o WHERE fe IS NULL
@@ R47 conflict update where guard bare
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = EXCLUDED.fe WHERE fe IS NULL
@@ R48 conflict update guard on EXCLUDED
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = EXCLUDED.fe WHERE EXCLUDED.fe IS NULL
@@ R49 fe = EXCLUDED other column under guard
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = EXCLUDED.pn WHERE repos.fe IS NULL
@@ R50 pnn incoming EXCLUDED other column
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET pnn = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.pn, repos.pnn)
